description: This file defines the procedural generation of a tile-based world map for a Metroidvania-style platformer game. It includes functions for creating map layouts with interconnected biomes, gate and secret placement, and world initialization logic. The file also provides functions related to gate passability and world state management.

methods.name: isGatePassable(gateTileId, tiles, playerAbilities)
methods.description: Checks if a specific gate tile is passable based on player's abilities and the gate type.

methods.name: computeUnlockedNodes(world)
methods.description: Determines which world nodes are unlocked based on current progress.

methods.name: createInitialWorld()
methods.description: Generates the initial world state including map layout, hazards, enemies, and progression markers.
